description: Combine exp204 (two-LUT block: out_proj + ffn) with exp205 (Q/K/V split). Attn sub-layer: x_pos = x + per-layer pos; Q,K from ln_qk(x_pos) -> V2D, V from ln_v(x) -> same V2D. Then SDPA -> LN -> LUT_out -> residual on x_pos. FFN sub-layer: LN -> LUT_ffn -> residual. Both LUTs: nap=6, tph=1536, n_sparse=32, n_alt=1, smooth=False. Per-block LUT: 2*1536*64*1*32 = 6.29M. Total ~87M.
